items.title: OpenAI researcher allegedly pressured mathematician to drop Anthropic co-author from math breakthrough paper
items.summary: Mathematician Tristan Buckmaster says an OpenAI researcher pressured him after information about his AI-assisted progress on the Navier-Stokes equations allegedly reached the company. The researcher tried to remove his co-author because he works at Anthropic and threatened Buckmaster when he refused, according to Buckmaster's account. OpenAI then claimed its own breakthrough using the same unusual solution path. Buckmaster had uploaded all his drafts to Codex. OpenAI told him the model didn't look up user data, but when he asked about training, he says he got no answer. OpenAI denies the allegations. The article OpenAI researcher allegedly pressured mathematician to drop Anthropic co-author from math breakthrough paper appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 數學家崔斯坦・巴克馬斯特（Tristan Buckmaster）表示，在據稱有關他利用 AI 協助納維-斯托克斯方程式（Navier-Stokes equations）進展的資訊傳到該公司後，一名 OpenAI 研究人員向他施壓。根據巴克馬斯特的說法，該研究人員試圖剔除他的共同作者，因為對方在 Anthropic 工作，並在巴克馬斯特拒絕時威脅了他。隨後，OpenAI 宣稱使用相同的非尋常解法取得了突破。巴克馬斯特將他所有的草稿都上傳到了 Codex。OpenAI 告訴他，該模型不會查詢使用者資料，但當他詢問關於訓練的問題時，他表示沒有得到任何答案。OpenAI 否認了這些指控。這篇題為 OpenAI 的文章「研究人員據稱施壓數學家，要求其在重大數學突破論文中剔除 Anthropic 共同作者」首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.summary: ASML has won over Samsung, TSMC, and Intel to switch to larger photomasks, which should boost the throughput of its newest EUV machines by 40 percent. Meanwhile, Huawei is orchestrating China's counter-strategy, aiming to break its dependence on the Dutch lithography technology through equipment maker Yuliangsheng and its own suppliers. items.title: 解決企業AI導入兩難，中華資安推出自研產品AI Archway，內建市場少見的可逆式脫敏機制
items.summary: 隨著生成式AI匯入企業的速度加快，機敏資料外洩的防護與影子AI的治理已成為企業與資安業者共同的課題。除了國際科技與資安大廠積極佈局AI Security，這幾年來，臺灣陸續有業者投入相關產品發展，中華資安國際也是其中之一，今年上半年正式進軍這塊市場，7月正式推出名為「AI安檢通道（AI Archway）」的產品。

items.title: Coca-Cola uses AI to improve retailer ordering in Malaysia
items.summary: Coca-Cola is using AI to recommend which products Malaysian retailers should order and in what quantities through its Coke Buddy platform. The Perfect Basket feature uses Coca-Cola’s Central Recommendation Engine to analyse previous orders, ordering frequency, seasonality, weather, and purchasing patterns among similar businesses. Coca-Cola said Coke Buddy currently supports about 39,000 retail outlets across […] The post Coca-Cola uses AI to improve retailer ordering in Malaysia appeared first on AI News .
items.summary_zh: 可口可樂（Coca-Cola）正在透過其 Coke Buddy 平臺利用人工智慧，向馬來西亞零售商推薦應訂購哪些產品以及具體數量。「完美購物籃」（Perfect Basket）功能採用可口可樂的中央推薦引擎，來分析類似商家先前的訂單、訂購頻率、季節性、天氣和購買模式。可口可樂表示，Coke Buddy 目前支援全馬約 39,000 個零售據點 […] 這篇文章 Coca-Cola uses AI to improve retailer ordering in Malaysia 最早出現於 AI News。

items.title: AI weather forecasting enters the energy market as Google targets grid operators with WeatherNext 3
items.summary: Google’s newest AI weather forecasting model predicts wind speed at 100 metres above the ground, roughly the height of a modern wind turbine. It also forecasts cloud cover and how much sunlight reaches the surface, and it updates every hour. Energy traders, grid operators and wind and solar developers already pay other companies for that […] The post AI weather forecasting enters the energy market as Google targets grid operators with WeatherNext 3 appeared first on AI News .
items.summary_zh: Google’s 最新的 AI 天氣預報模型能預測地面上方 100 公尺處的風速，大約相當於現代風力發電機的高度。它還能預測雲層覆蓋率以及到達地面的日照量，並且每小時更新一次。能源交易商、電網營運商以及風能和太陽能開發商已經在向其他公司支付費用來獲得這些資訊 […] 這篇文章 AI weather forecasting enters the energy market as Google targets grid operators with WeatherNext 3 最早出現於 AI News 。

items.title: YouTube Appears in 53% of Google AI Overviews for Vitamin and Supplement Searches
items.summary: YouTube was the most frequently cited website in Google AI Overviews across a panel of vitamin and supplement searches, according to new research. The video platform appeared in 186 of 350 AI-generated answers, or 53.1%, making it the only website cited in more than half of the answers collected. Searcherries followed 50 searches daily from […] The post YouTube Appears in 53% of Google AI Overviews for Vitamin and Supplement Searches appeared first on AI News .
items.summary_zh: 根據一項最新研究，在一組維生素和補充品搜尋面板中，YouTube 是 Google AI Overviews 中被引用最頻繁的網站。該影片平臺出現在 350 個 AI 生成答案中的 186 個，佔 53.1%，成為唯一在超過半數收集到的答案中被引用的網站。Searcherries 每天追蹤 50 次搜尋 […] 這篇文章 YouTube Appears in 53% of Google AI Overviews for Vitamin and Supplement Searches 最早出現於 AI News 。

items.title: HiddenLayer獲得1億美元B輪融資，擴大AI代理執行階段安全防護
items.summary: AI資安業者HiddenLayer宣佈完成1億美元B輪融資，將運用這筆資金持續擴充AI安全平臺，並投入工程、研究及業務拓展。 HiddenLayer既有產品涵蓋生成式AI、預測式AI與AI代理，提供資產探索、供應鏈安全、攻擊模擬及執行階段防護等功能。今年則進一步強化AI代理實際執行任務時的安全控管。

items.title: DeepSeek招募150名資深工程師 重點加碼Agent工程化與DSec基建
items.summary: 9月8日，DeepSeek啓動約150人工程師招聘，聚焦服務端開發與Agent彈性計算研發，重點招2至10年資深後端工程師，未設AI研究崗。這是繼6月全部門擴招後又一動作，顯示戰略重心從純模型研究轉向Agent工程化與基礎設施建設，涉及大模型研究平臺、Agent框架組件及DeepSeek API。

items.title: 臺灣大哥大發表MyAgent平臺，加速從AI助理走向數位員工
items.summary: 生成式 AI 技術熱炒了兩年，市場正從「問答聊天」迅速轉向能代勞實際工作流程的 AI Agent。臺灣大哥大今天（9/8）舉辦「D.E.E.P. Tech Day 2026」硬科技日，發表其自研的企業級AI Agent平臺MyAgent，並和精誠資訊聯手，試圖解決企業匯入AI時面臨的算力成本、模型選擇、資料安全與系統整合等問題。

items.title: Palo Alto Networks揭露攻擊者利用AI代理在10小時內攻破企業網路，竊取root憑證
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks研究人員於9月2日揭露一起企業網路入侵事件，發現攻擊者利用頂尖AI模型及專用AI代理框架，在不到10小時內，完成原本以人力需要花費大約兩週時間的入侵流程。研究人員發現，攻擊者並未利用全新零時差漏洞或特殊攻擊技術，而是藉由AI代理大幅提高攻擊鏈的速度。

items.title: AI重建16.6萬神經元果蠅中樞神經圖，可追蹤感官與動作路徑
items.summary: 美國霍華休斯醫學研究所（HHMI）旗下Janelia Research Campus與Google Research等團隊，利用AI重建神經元3D結構，完成雄性黑腹果蠅完整中樞神經系統連線圖，相關論文刊登於《Cell》。研究資料涵蓋超過16.6萬個神經元與1.25億個突觸連接，範圍從腦部延伸到控制身體動作的腹神經索，可追蹤視覺、聽覺與嗅覺等感官訊號到動作輸出。

items.title: Introducing ChatGPT Images 2.5
items.summary: Introducing ChatGPT Images 2.5 OpenAI's image generation models are apparently used "more than 3 billion images across ChatGPT Images and the GPT‑Image models in the API". This latest release improves their instruction-following ability across multiple turns, responds faster, and "is better at preserving the subjects in your reference photos". There are two new model IDs in the API: gpt-image-2.5-sunburst and gpt-image-2.5-flare . Based on this I think Sunburst is the stronger option: Choose Sunburst for workflows where editing precision matters most, and Flare for fast, high-quality everyday image generation. I upgraded my openai_image.py CLI tool to support passing in one or more reference images, so now this works: uv run https://tools.simonwillison.net/python/openai_image.py \ ' add a raccoon scientist studying the chart thoughtfully ' \ -i https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2026/openai-agent-usage.webp \ -m gpt-image-2.5-sunburst This is the original image , and here's what I got back from that prompt to "add a raccoon scientist studying the chart thoughtfully": Tags: tools , ai , openai , generative-ai , uv , text-to-image
items.summary_zh: 推出 ChatGPT Images 2.5。OpenAI's 圖片生成模型顯然「在 API 中的 ChatGPT Images 和 GPT‑Image 模型中共生成了超過 30 億張圖片」。這最新版本提升了它們在多輪對話中的指令遵循能力、回應速度更快，並且「更能完美保留參考照片中的主體」。API 中加入了兩個新的模型 ID：gpt-image-2.5-sunburst 與 gpt-image-2.5-flare。基於此，我認為 Sunburst 是更強大的選項：針對最重視編輯精準度的工作流程，請選擇 Sunburst；若是追求快速、高品質的日常圖片生成，則選擇 Flare。我升級了我的 openai_image.py CLI 工具以支援傳入一個或幾個參考圖片，所以現在這樣做可行：uv run https://tools.simonwillison.net/python/openai_image.py \ ' add a raccoon scientist studying the chart thoughtfully ' \ -i https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2026/openai-agent-usage.webp \ -m gpt-image-2.5-sunburst 這是原始圖片，這是我用「add a raccoon scientist studying the chart thoughtfully」這個提示詞所得到的結果：標籤：tools、ai、openai、generative-ai、uv、text-to-image

items_ai.title: OpenAI researcher allegedly pressured mathematician to drop Anthropic co-author from math breakthrough paper
items_ai.summary: Mathematician Tristan Buckmaster says an OpenAI researcher pressured him after information about his AI-assisted progress on the Navier-Stokes equations allegedly reached the company. The researcher tried to remove his co-author because he works at Anthropic and threatened Buckmaster when he refused, according to Buckmaster's account. OpenAI then claimed its own breakthrough using the same unusual solution path. Buckmaster had uploaded all his drafts to Codex. OpenAI told him the model didn't look up user data, but when he asked about training, he says he got no answer. OpenAI denies the allegations. The article OpenAI researcher allegedly pressured mathematician to drop Anthropic co-author from math breakthrough paper appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 數學家崔斯坦・巴克馬斯特（Tristan Buckmaster）表示，在據稱有關他利用 AI 協助納維-斯托克斯方程式（Navier-Stokes equations）進展的資訊傳到該公司後，一名 OpenAI 研究人員向他施壓。根據巴克馬斯特的說法，該研究人員試圖剔除他的共同作者，因為對方在 Anthropic 工作，並在巴克馬斯特拒絕時威脅了他。隨後，OpenAI 宣稱使用相同的非尋常解法取得了突破。巴克馬斯特將他所有的草稿都上傳到了 Codex。OpenAI 告訴他，該模型不會查詢使用者資料，但當他詢問關於訓練的問題時，他表示沒有得到任何答案。OpenAI 否認了這些指控。這篇題為 OpenAI 的文章「研究人員據稱施壓數學家，要求其在重大數學突破論文中剔除 Anthropic 共同作者」首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_ai.title: Introducing ChatGPT Images 2.5
items_ai.summary: Introducing ChatGPT Images 2.5 OpenAI's image generation models are apparently used "more than 3 billion images across ChatGPT Images and the GPT‑Image models in the API". This latest release improves their instruction-following ability across multiple turns, responds faster, and "is better at preserving the subjects in your reference photos". There are two new model IDs in the API: gpt-image-2.5-sunburst and gpt-image-2.5-flare . Based on this I think Sunburst is the stronger option: Choose Sunburst for workflows where editing precision matters most, and Flare for fast, high-quality everyday image generation. I upgraded my openai_image.py CLI tool to support passing in one or more reference images, so now this works: uv run https://tools.simonwillison.net/python/openai_image.py \ ' add a raccoon scientist studying the chart thoughtfully ' \ -i https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2026/openai-agent-usage.webp \ -m gpt-image-2.5-sunburst This is the original image , and here's what I got back from that prompt to "add a raccoon scientist studying the chart thoughtfully": Tags: tools , ai , openai , generative-ai , uv , text-to-image
